title: The specified model compact-support comparison is the proper-unit map
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $f=a_X:X\to s$. Let $\Phi$ be the $k$-linear model Frobenius, the base change of the $q$-power Frobenius of $X_0$, and let $h=\Phi^r$, $r\geq1$. Write $\mathcal D_T=D^b_c(T)[[\underline\Omega]]$ for the actual bounded constructible module-object category with $\underline\Omega=\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Use its restricted derived pullback/direct-image adjunction [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors] with this coefficient ring, and its chosen-compactification functor $P=Rf_!^{\mathrm{cond}}$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek].

For $M\in\mathcal D_X$, define the proper-unit map $d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,M}:PM\to PLh^*M$ by the ordered composite
$$PM\xrightarrow{P(\eta_{h,M})}PRh_*Lh^*M\xrightarrow{P(Rh_*\simeq Rh_!)}PRh_!Lh^*M\xrightarrow{\mathrm{comp}}R(fh)_!Lh^*M\xrightarrow{fh=f}PLh^*M.$$
Here $\eta_h$ is the unit of $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$, and every proper-coincidence and composition comparison is the one used by the module-object compact-support construction, including comparison with the chosen compactifications. Properness holds because $h$ is a positive iterate of finite model Frobenius [lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial]. Let $\Theta_{h,M}:PM\to PLh^*M$ be the underlying arrow of the specific compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison used to define weilCompactCohomology for $h$ in [nt-assume-trace-formula], after the canonical identity pullback on $s$ is removed. Then
$$\Theta_{h,M}=d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,M}.$$
This equality is natural in $M$. In particular the globalOperator of any Weil object $(M,w:Lh^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}M)$ in that interface is $P(w)\circ d^{\mathrm{cond}}_{h,M}$. No adic coefficients, geometric Galois Frobenius, trace identity, or duality is asserted.

source.place: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison, weilCompactCohomology and WeilBoundedConstructibleOfEnd.globalOperator (the archive cited by nt-assume-trace-formula). The definition of compactCohomologyFrobeniusComparison is literally the composite: identity pullback on s (boundedConstructibleUpperStarId with unitors), the unit of boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction for Phi, the inverse of boundedConstructibleLowerShriekIsoLowerStar_padicAlgCl, the inverse of boundedConstructibleLowerShriekComp_padicAlgCl, and eqToIso for Phi >> a_X = a_X; weilCompactCohomology is IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso of it and globalOperator is its frobenius.hom for the m-th iterate between eqToHom casts. Read by the maintainer reader in the read-only checkout lean/WeilConjectures/TraceFormula/Statement.lean, lines 108-148 and 182-196, whose declarations and docstrings are those named by nt-assume-trace-formula. The asserted equality is the unfolding of this definition; the blueprint counterpart of the recipe is sec-trace-formula/sk-d-weil/_section.md (global graph-operator paragraph) and prop-trf-graph-operator.proof.md.
